argv: SELECT CASE WHEN "file_id" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("file_id" AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN "class_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("class_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "class_idx",CASE WHEN "annotations_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotations_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotations_off",CASE WHEN "entry_kind" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("entry_kind" AS TEXT)) END AS "entry_kind",CASE WHEN "entry_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("entry_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "entry_idx",CASE WHEN "annotation_set_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotation_set_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotation_set_off",CASE WHEN "annotation_set_ref_list_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotation_set_ref_list_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotation_set_ref_list_off" FROM annotation_directory_entries ORDER BY file_id,annotations_off,entry_kind,entry_idx
